dog.description_text:
Introducing Oscar! He is a sweet and adorable 4-month-old, 10-pound Lab mix who is ready to find his forever home! Oscar is the perfect little bundle of puppy joy, with a playful personality and the best smile that is guaranteed to brighten your day! He loves wrestling with his littermates, strolling around the park, and showing off his silly side. But don't let his playful energy fool you — Oscar is also a professional napper! You'll often find him passed out on his back with his belly in the air or cozied up in his comfy bed, happily people-watching for hours before he's ready to jump back into the action. This happy-go-lucky boy has the best of both worlds: playful puppy adventures and plenty of opportunities for snuggles and relaxation. He's looking for a family who wants all the fun, laughter, cuddles, and unforgettable memories that come with raising a puppy. If you're looking for a little best friend to share your walks, fill your days with laughter, and curl up with after a long day, Oscar might just be your perfect match!

Oscar is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on his vaccinations. For more information about him, please fill out an application at www.ALRcares.com and email Rachel@alrcares.com. We schedule meet and greets for approved adopters only, an application is the first step in our approval process. Thank you!
